In recent years, the Oregon Legislature has amended certain laws to make things less harsh for certain of our clients. For example, Oregon’s expungement law has been improved to eliminate the filing fee, make the process more user friendly, shorten certain waiting periods, and enable people to qualify for expungement where they previously were not eligible. Similarly, Oregon laws have been improved considerably for persons seeking relief from sex offender registration, or adjustment of their registration status. Anyone who would potentially benefit from these changes in Oregon law should contact us and we can discuss whether they have additional options for seeking relief.
